title: Go live
caption: Owner only, FEATURE_LIVE_SWITCH on, step-up within 15 minutes.

steps.title: Go live
steps.expect: All met: `storefront_environment = 'live'`, live payment connection created from the test one, audit `tenant.went_live`. Missing: `422 LIVE_PRECONDITIONS_UNMET` with `details.missing` among amadeus_live, payments_live, payout_account, plan_live_mode, subscription, mfa.

steps.title: After
steps.expect: Live keys allowed; every owner/admin without MFA now gets `403 MFA_REQUIRED` (`enrolment_required`).
